enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up hairbrush. Brush hair. Look in mirror. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Pick up bag. Turn off light. Exit bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open patient files. Review records. Answer phone. Talk to patient. Take notes. Stand up. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk back to desk. Type report. Stand up. Walk to break room. Pour coffee. Sit down. Drink coffee. Walk back to desk.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

Pick up plate. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Pick up glass. Rinse glass. Place glass in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Press power button. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Save document. Close program. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.
